migration_notes: Goal: seamless hosted-to-dedicated migration w/ compatibility shim that emulates legacy tokenization+sampling defaults.
POC tests: unit prompt parity suite (300 prompts), nlg-eval corpus (1k cases), embedding cosine parity for search intent clustering.
Observed diffs: token offsets differ on unicode emojis and zero-width joiners; KV cache behavior affects multi-turn latency on long context windows.
Mitigation planned: token normalization preprocessor, controlled sampling seed, per-route model variant routing, and a regression alert dashboard tied to eval set.
Rollout plan: Hosted POC -> Dedicated staging pool -> 10% canary -> 50% -> 100% with automatic fallback to Hosted variants if quality regressions exceed threshold.
